notes.title: Explore human body as a vaccine: Nineteen's full version now live!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is CFK.

We are proud to announce that the full version of Nineteen has finally gone live!

Based on various user feedbacks collected during Early Access, we made a number of improvements to the full version, which includes game balancing, a new game mode, and a bunch of story cutscenes.

In the full version, the gameplay is more flexible with three types of jump command(short, normal, and long), and more convenient with "Aura", which is Nineteen's ability to help the player estimate the distance of each jump.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41322929/4fa2912f163963cbd375d25926f753c441f60850.jpg[/img]

The new game mode "Booster Shot"(i.e. booster dose) is for those who felt the Early Access version was too difficult. In this mode, the player can use a jetpack to stay in mid-air for a few seconds, allowing them to better understand the stage. There is also a new ending for Mongryong Lee in the full version, so check it out!

We would like to thank everyone who gave us support during the Early Access. Thanks to your feedbacks, we were able to make the game much better. We would be grateful for your continued support and interest in our games. Thank you.

notes.title: Nineteen Upadate Notes - 10/19/2021
notes.notes:
1. Players will now see an egg floating above Nineteen's head. A chick will hatch and grow as death count increases.
[list]
[*]0 - 99 Deaths: Egg
[*]100 - 299 Deaths: Chick
[*]300 - 499 Deaths: Chicken
[*]500 Deaths and up: Golden Chicken
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41322929/2c8c2bf87c75fbc734c24078d49482c403479206.jpg[/img]


2. A progress bar has been added. It will gradually fill up as players reach a save point in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41322929/959e055da3b207b7927b89c9b1367fe7edba9a60.jpg[/img]


3. Bonus save points will appear when players fail more than 100 times at certain locations.
(Reaching the existing save points will remove them.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41322929/0c43d8e903b13acefa076bfb4f8f78951cb17ebc.jpg[/img]


4. Japanese is now available.
Players can change in-game language by following the steps below:

[list]
[*]Run Steam
[*]Library → Nineteen → Right-Mouse Click → Select "Properties"
[*]Language → Select "Japanese"
[*]Play
[/list]

We deeply appreciate your interest, and your time on playing 「Nineteen」.
Feedbacks will be collected from around the world during the Early Access, and use to improve the game before full release.

We will keep up the hard work to meet your expectations.
